title: Effect of board games on the social skills development of at-risk children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in upper elementary schools in Thailand
core_idea: Evaluate whether a board game program specifically designed to enhance social skills can be used as an intervention for at-risk upper elementary students diagnosed with ADHD in Thailand, using a quasi-experimental design with control and experimental groups and assessment via a social skills questionnaire and social behavior interview.
tldr: A quasi-experimental study testing a board game intervention to improve social skills among at-risk elementary students with ADHD in Thailand, assessed with questionnaires and interviews.
